metadata.description: Storage-free native Consumption Logic Apps with run-history and Log Analytics audit.
metadata.runtime: No customer Storage account, Python, JavaScript, Azure Functions, Integration Account or LLM.

metadata.description: Earliest allowed manual publication date, not a persistent catch-up cursor.
Tokyo local YYYY-MM-DDT08:00:00 without Z/offset. Use a time before 09:00: a start time exactly at the 09:00 schedule instant skips that first occurrence.
Sets only worker SecureString NvdApiKey. No Key Vault.
Create the Office 365 Outlook API connection. Redeploying may reset its authorization; set false after the first authorization.
Existing workspace resource ID; empty means run history only.

properties.description: Complete publication-day pages; workflow-supplied secure header; no severity prefilter.

info.title: NVD Daily Publication Pages
info.description: Read every NVD publication-day page. Severity filters are deliberately absent; all CVSS 4.0 and 3.1 assessment sources are evaluated by the workflow.

get.description: Use a completed JST day converted to UTC. Advance startIndex by the actual response length until totalResults is reached. resultsPerPage is a page size, never a total-result cap.

parameters.name: apiKey
parameters.description: Supplied at runtime from the worker's SecureString NvdApiKey parameter, never connector credentials.

parameters.name: pubStartDate
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC start with milliseconds and Z

parameters.name: pubEndDate
parameters.description: Inclusive UTC end: next JST midnight minus one millisecond

200.description: NVD CVEs and complete pagination metadata

403.description: Invalid key or access denied; not zero results

503.description: Transient upstream failure; safe GET retry
